---
kind: chapter
n: 1
title: The Puddle Duck
round: 0
words: 400
---

SCENE: The garden, morning. Mira kneels by a big silver puddle in her yellow raincoat and red boots, and a tiny grey duck peeks out of the water.
ON SCREEN: Mira (yellow raincoat, red boots, curious)
The rain has stopped. The puddle is as round as a plate.

SCENE: The garden, morning. The little duck climbs out of the puddle and stands on the wet grass beside Mira.
ON SCREEN: Mira (kneeling), Pip (small grey duckling, yellow beak)
The duck has big feet and a very small tail. It peeps at Mira.

SCENE: The garden, morning. The duckling shakes itself from head to tail, and silver drops fly all around it in the sunshine.
ON SCREEN: Pip (grey duckling, dripping)
Flap, flap, flap! The drops make tiny rainbows.

SCENE: The garden, morning. The duckling hops onto Mira's red boot and looks up at her with round black eyes.
ON SCREEN: Mira (smiling), Pip (on a red boot)
"You are a puddle duck," Mira whispers. The duck peeps again.

SCENE: The path, morning. Mira walks along the stone path between tall wet grass and daisies, and the little duck waddles behind her.
ON SCREEN: Mira (yellow raincoat), Pip (following)
The stones are slippery. Mira takes one slow step, then another.

SCENE: The path, morning. The duckling sits down in the grass and tucks its beak under its wing, too tired to walk.
ON SCREEN: Pip (tired, in tall grass)
Pip has walked a long way for such small feet. It needs a rest.

SCENE: The path, morning. Mira carries the duckling in her arms, and it hides its head under her chin.
ON SCREEN: Mira (carrying Pip), Pip (sleepy)
"You are light as a feather," says Mira. The duck is warm and soft.

SCENE: The pond, midday. Over the wall the duckling sees a round green pond with lily pads and reeds, and it flaps its little wings.
ON SCREEN: Pip (excited), Mira (at the wall)
The pond shines in the sun. Pip knows this water.

SCENE: The pond, midday. The duckling jumps into the pond with a splash and swims in a happy circle beside Mira.
ON SCREEN: Mira (on the bench), Pip (swimming)
Splash, splash! The water makes rings all the way to the reeds.

SCENE: The pond, midday. Pip pushes a green lily pad with its beak, and a tiny frog sits on it like a captain.
ON SCREEN: Pip (paddling), Mira (laughing)
The frog blinks once. Then it hops away into the reeds.

SCENE: The pond, afternoon. Mira stands up from the bench and waves to the duckling, and Pip lifts one wing to wave back.
ON SCREEN: Mira (waving), Pip (bobbing)
"Goodbye, puddle duck," says Mira. "Come and visit my garden."

SCENE: The kitchen, evening. Mama meets Mira at the kitchen door and looks at her muddy boots with a small smile.
ON SCREEN: Mira (muddy boots), Mama (green cardigan, smiling)
"You have been busy," says Mama. "There is a duck in your hair too."

SCENE: The kitchen, evening. Mira sits at the wooden table with dry socks and a cup of cocoa, and Mama pours one for herself.
ON SCREEN: Mira (dry socks, happy), Mama (pouring cocoa)
The kettle sings. The cocoa is warm and sweet.

SCENE: The kitchen, night. Mira looks out of the window at the garden, where the big puddle is full of stars and one small moon.
ON SCREEN: Mira (at the window, sleepy)
The puddle glows like a little pond. "Goodnight, puddle," Mira says.
